question: What exact Loom HTTP execution, status, tracing and authentication interfaces can this app use? Existing raw /v1/weave request is unverified; retain explicit demonstration until verified.
probes: Inspect upstream README, API proto and authentication documentation
Check whether a configured local Loom service exists
resolution: Verified the interface from /home/ed/work/loom/proto/loom/v1/loom.proto (WeaveRequest/Response, streaming and agent routes) and pkg/server/http.go (/health and SSE). POST /v1/weave accepts query and returns text with optional session/trace IDs. Adapter covers loopback HTTP chat; streaming, session continuity, authenticated desktop deployments and execution updates remain unsupported and documented in docs/loom-integration.md. Runtime connectivity could not be established because local sockets are restricted. Demonstration labels remain visible regardless of chat health.
